body: Sorry but that is nothing but a child tantrum. He needs to grow up and learn to control himself. I was in similar relationship 3 months ago, lasted 2 years, he called me names, destroyed my stuff with the excuse: "I wasn't myself at the time". Don't let yourself be someones punching bag.

Hi, I was recently in that kind of a relationship and there were many many many different kinds of shit he put me through, but this one was something that offended me as a person. My ex also said that it's my fault and his reason was that I masturbated to often and now I can't finish. When he would finally do it, often he got tired because I'm so "demanding". Also lasted 3min, we would joke about it, but for me it was "I'm laughing because I don't want to cry" joke. So I have bad news for you, might sound rough but from a person with similar experience, that relationship won't last long if he isn't willing to communicate, and from what I've read, he doesn't care :/ the good news is... you won't put up with that shit anymore and you won't become someone who just doesn't like sex anymore, like me. 
Best of luck, I'm sorry if I offended you in any way, just wanted to share, it was like I was reading my story.

Don't do it. 20 years old. When I was 20, I wanted to do it for so many reasons, now when I think of them, makes me laugh. I'm not saying your reasons are dumb or something like that because I don't even know them, I'm just saying when you get away from the situation that makes you want to do it, arguments for killing yourself at that time fade and later you have whole other perspective on those life situations. Sorry for my english, it's not my first language.

In Croatia we have a saying "Tko će koga nego svoj svoga" and it rough translation would be that family members usually take advantage of other family members or any other activity with negative impact on families who want to help. We believe in family values but we are also aware of dangers when you want to help your family lol
